visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Real-life footage begins with two hosts, a male and a female, standing in front of a green rolling shutter door. They both wear white, traditional Chinese-style mandarin collar jackets with a small circular logo. The male host on the right holds a yellow HahaTai microphone sign. They speak with energetic facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white fabric banner hanging above a shop entrance. The banner displays large, handwritten red characters "割包皮 Q". A white stick points to the text, emphasizing the unique name. The background reveals a brick-patterned wall and some green potted plants. (3) The perspective shifts to an indoor interview inside a small eatery. The two hosts are seated at a wooden table, talking to a male shop owner. The owner wears a black t-shirt, a blue medical mask, and distinctive purple nitrile gloves. The walls are decorated with white brick wallpaper and shelves containing small potted succulents. (4) Close-up shots capture the hosts' exaggerated laughter and reactions. The male host leans back with his mouth open in surprise, while the female host smiles broadly. The shop owner gestures with his gloved hands as he explains the history of the shop's sign. (5) Outdoor scene featuring the male host eating a Taiwanese "Gua Bao" burger. Close-up macro shots show the ingredients: thick slices of braised pork, pickled mustard greens (suancai), peanut powder with sugar, and fresh cilantro tucked into a white steamed bun. He takes a large bite and shows a satisfied expression. (6) Final group shot outdoors where the two hosts and the shop owner stand together. The shop owner gives a thumbs up to the camera. They appear to be shouting a slogan together while holding the yellow HahaTai microphone sign in front of a menu board listing various noodle and rice dishes.

A second male voice (the shop owner) joins with a calm but conversational pitch. Frequent bursts of group laughter and 'Pop' UI sound effects punctuate the dialogue.
